title: TODO or FIXME in touched surface cannot be ignored
summary: The agent encounters a TODO, FIXME, or HACK in the exact file, doc section, or workflow surface already being edited.
currentFailure: The agent treats the marker as historical context only and moves on without fixing it, or tries to close the bug with another TODO instead of real work.

surfaceChecks.description: TODO and FIXME markers in touched surfaces trigger real closure work, not more TODOs.
patterns: A TODO comment is not bug closure

surfaceChecks.description: Always-on routing explicitly mentions TODO and FIXME discoveries.

samples.noncompliant: I saw the FIXME, but it looks like historical context only and not my task, so I left it as-is.
samples.compliant: The FIXME is in the exact surface I am touching, so I need to fix it now. If the fix turns out to be unsafe, I need to stop and ask instead of treating the TODO as closure.
